entries.en: There are a hundred and one things to finish before the exhibition opens.
entries.zh: 展览开幕前，还有许许多多的事情要完成。

entries.en: She found a thousand and one reasons to postpone the difficult conversation.
entries.zh: 她找了许许多多的理由，想把那场难以启齿的谈话往后拖。

entries.en: You may donate any amount of money, however small it seems.
entries.zh: 你可以捐出任意数额的钱，哪怕看起来很少。

entries.en: Take as many as you need, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
entries.zh: 需要多少就拿多少，其余的留到明天。

entries.en: Far be it from me to think that my opinion is the only one that matters.
entries.zh: 我绝不会认为只有自己的意见才重要。

entries.en: For pity's sake, stop arguing and listen to what she is trying to tell you.
entries.zh: 求求你们，别吵了，听听她到底想告诉你们什么。

entries.en: If worst comes to worst, we can stay with my cousin.
entries.zh: 如果情况糟到最坏的地步，我们可以住到我表亲家里。

entries.en: A little less noise, if you please; I'm trying to read.
entries.zh: 请安静一点，我正在看书。

entries.en: There is no love lost between the two colleagues, despite their polite smiles.
entries.zh: 尽管脸上带着客气的笑容，这两位同事其实彼此厌恶。

entries.en: Send not more than five photographs with your application, and label each one clearly.
entries.zh: 申请时附上的照片不要超过五张，每张都要标注清楚。

entries.en: An overseas holiday is simply not on this year, given our tight budget.
entries.zh: 今年预算这么紧，根本没法出国度假。

entries.en: We agreed to use one person one vote when choosing the new club leader.
entries.zh: 我们同意在选新社团负责人时采用一人一票的办法。

entries.en: You don't have to bring a gift or anything; just come along.
entries.zh: 你不用带礼物什么的，人来就好。

entries.en: Let me know whether you can join us or not.
entries.zh: 请告诉我你能不能和我们一起参加。

entries.en: So far as I know, the final decision has not been made.
entries.zh: 据我所知，最终决定还没有作出。

entries.en: We spent the better part of the afternoon untangling the cables.
entries.zh: 我们花了下午的大部分时间来理清缠在一起的电线。

entries.en: There is no question of abandoning the project after so much work.
entries.zh: 投入了这么多心血，我们不可能放弃这个项目。

entries.en: The cost of repairs is another factor to be reckoned with.
entries.zh: 维修费用是另一个需要认真考虑的因素。

entries.en: The room had no windows to speak of, just a narrow slit near the ceiling.
entries.zh: 那个房间没什么像样的窗户，只有靠近天花板的一道窄缝。

entries.en: Truth to tell, I was relieved when the meeting was cancelled.
entries.zh: 老实说，得知会议取消时，我松了一口气。

entries.en: Uh huh, I see why you moved the desk closer to the window.
entries.zh: 嗯，我明白你为什么把书桌挪得更靠近窗户了。

entries.en: What the heck happened to all the labels on these folders?
entries.zh: 这些文件夹上的标签到底都怎么了？

entries.en: What's up with the printer today? It keeps stopping halfway through each page.
entries.zh: 打印机今天是怎么回事？每页打印到一半就停下来。

entries.en: Whoops, I sent the attachment to the wrong address.
entries.zh: 哎呀，我把附件发错地址了。

entries.en: She reread the instructions in order to avoid repeating the same mistake.
entries.zh: 为了避免再犯同样的错误，她重新读了一遍说明。

entries.en: The path was flooded, so that we had to turn back.
entries.zh: 小路被水淹了，所以我们只好折返。

entries.meaningZh: 一连串乱七八糟的脏话。
entries.en: His explanation dissolved into a jumble of swear words when the screen went blank.
entries.zh: 屏幕没了显示时，他的解释就变成了一连串乱七八糟的脏话。

entries.en: A stab of pain went through her when she saw the empty chair.
entries.zh: 看到那把空椅子时，她心里突然一阵刺痛。

entries.en: I sketch as the mood takes me, rather than following a daily routine.
entries.zh: 我随兴致画素描，而不是每天按固定的安排来画。

entries.en: The station was crawling with reporters after the unexpected announcement.
entries.zh: 那条意外的消息宣布后，车站里挤满了记者。

entries.en: We were for it when the teacher found the broken window.
entries.zh: 老师发现那扇被打破的窗户时，我们就要倒霉了。

entries.en: She seemed to be taken by his calm manner and careful choice of words.
entries.zh: 她似乎被他沉稳的举止和斟酌过的措辞打动了。

entries.meaningZh: 因出乎意料的事而一时慌乱
entries.en: I was thrown by the sudden change of subject and lost my train of thought.
entries.zh: 话题突然一变，我一时不知如何应对，思路也断了。

entries.meaningZh: 低劣或微不足道得连鄙视都不值得的
entries.en: She dismissed the malicious rumour as beneath her contempt.
entries.zh: 她觉得那条恶意谣言连鄙视都不值得，根本不屑理会。

entries.meaningZh: 聚精会神地听某人说的每一句话
entries.en: The children hung on the storyteller's every word until the final candle burned low.
entries.zh: 直到最后一支蜡烛快燃尽，孩子们仍全神贯注地听着讲故事的人说的每一句话。

entries.meaningZh: 对某人怀恨在心、存心找茬
entries.en: She seemed to have it in for me after I questioned her decision.
entries.zh: 我质疑她的决定之后，她似乎就总想找我的茬。

entries.en: She held the door shut to keep the intruder at bay.
entries.zh: 她抵住门不让它打开，以此挡住闯入者。

entries.en: I thought I was losing my marbles when I couldn't find my keys in my own bag.
entries.zh: 在自己的包里找不到钥匙时，我还以为自己脑子糊涂了。

entries.term: make a show of doing something
entries.en: He made a show of helping us pack, but left before the heavy work began.
entries.zh: 他摆出帮我们收拾打包的样子，却在真正繁重的活儿开始之前就走了。

entries.meaningZh: 原地等待而不取得进展
entries.en: We were marking time at the office until the new contract was signed.
entries.zh: 新合同签署之前，我们在办公室里只是原地等待，工作毫无进展。

entries.en: It is perfectly all right to ask for clarification when the instructions seem unclear.
entries.zh: 如果觉得说明不清楚，要求进一步解释完全没问题。

entries.meaningZh: 把不愉快的事放到一边，继续向前
entries.en: It took her months to put the bitter argument behind her and rebuild their friendship.
entries.zh: 她用了几个月才把那场充满怨怼的争吵抛在身后，并重建了两人的友谊。

entries.meaningZh: 补救、弥补被弄糟的事情
entries.en: I want to put things right before this mistake damages our friendship.
entries.zh: 我想在这个错误损害我们的友谊之前把事情补救好。

entries.meaningZh: 下定决心要得到某物或实现某事
entries.en: She had set her heart on studying abroad, even though the application process looked daunting.
entries.zh: 她一心想出国留学，尽管申请流程看起来令人望而生畏。

entries.meaningZh: 使一连串后续事情开始发生
entries.en: The new director's arrival set a series of changes in motion.
entries.zh: 新主管的到来引发了一连串变化。

entries.en: She shot daggers at me when I laughed during her serious announcement.
entries.zh: 她郑重宣布事情时，我笑了出来，她便狠狠瞪着我。

entries.en: I reread the final paragraph, and then the penny dropped.
entries.zh: 我重读了最后一段，这才恍然大悟。

entries.meaningZh: 非常欣赏、看重或喜爱某人
entries.en: My grandfather thought the world of the neighbour who checked on him each morning.
entries.zh: 祖父十分喜爱那位每天早上来看望他的邻居。

entries.meaningZh: 恰好相隔这么长时间，准确到某一天
entries.en: We met again ten years to the day after our last conversation.
entries.zh: 距离上次交谈整整十年后，我们又见面了，一天不差。

entries.term: turn something over in one's mind
entries.en: I kept turning her final remark over in my mind on the walk home.
entries.zh: 回家的路上，我一直在脑海里反复琢磨她最后说的那句话。

entries.en: After the repeated delays, he decided to wash his hands of the entire scheme.
entries.zh: 接连拖延之后，他决定彻底不再插手整个计划。

entries.term: when all is said and done
entries.en: When all is said and done, the decision is yours, not ours.
entries.zh: 说到底，决定权在你，而不在我们。

entries.en: Finishing the first draft by Friday is still within the realms of possibility.
entries.zh: 周五之前完成初稿，还是有可能的。

entries.en: I finally worked up the nerve to ask whether my proposal had been rejected.
entries.zh: 我终于鼓起勇气，问自己的提案是不是被否决了。

entries.en: I can't make sense of the instructions without seeing the diagram.
entries.zh: 不看示意图，我就无法理解这些说明。

entries.en: He's unusually quiet today, though he usually starts every conversation.
entries.zh: 他今天异常安静，尽管平时每次谈话都是他先开口。

entries.meaningZh: we are 的常用口语形式
entries.en: We're still waiting for confirmation before we book the tickets.
entries.zh: 我们还在等确认消息，然后才订票。

entries.meaningZh: we have 的常用口语形式
entries.en: We've already checked the figures twice, but one total still seems wrong.
entries.zh: 我们已经核对过两遍数字了，但有个总数似乎仍不正确。

entries.en: He'd already left the office when your message arrived.
entries.zh: 你的消息到来时，他已经离开办公室了。

entries.en: He'll explain the changes once everyone has a copy of the revised plan.
entries.zh: 等每个人都拿到修改后的计划，他就会解释有哪些变动。

entries.en: It'll take more than a quick apology to rebuild their trust.
entries.zh: 要重建他们的信任，远不止匆匆道个歉这么简单。

entries.en: Please send a short bio describing your research interests and recent work.
entries.zh: 请发来一份简短的个人简介，介绍你的研究兴趣和近期工作。

entries.en: The report gives the measured concentration in ppm rather than as a percentage.
entries.zh: 报告用百万分率而不是百分比来表示测得的浓度。

entries.en: We are judging the essay qua argument, not as a piece of entertainment.
entries.zh: 我们是在把这篇文章当作论证来评价，而不是把它当作消遣作品。

entries.en: The alarm sounds iff both switches are on.
entries.zh: 当且仅当两个开关均处于开启状态时，警报才会响。

entries.en: The band mixed ska with the slower rhythms of their earlier songs.
entries.zh: 乐队把斯卡音乐和他们早期歌曲中较慢的节奏融合在一起。

entries.en: A roo paused beside the fence before hopping back into the scrub.
entries.zh: 一只袋鼠在围栏旁停了一会儿，随后又跳回灌木丛。

entries.en: He asked for a mug of cha before settling down to read.
entries.zh: 他要了一大杯茶，然后才安坐下来读书。

entries.en: The biologist examined the ova under a microscope and recorded their appearance.
entries.zh: 生物学家在显微镜下观察卵细胞，并记录了它们的外观。

entries.en: He hid the unfinished letter beneath a stack of newspapers.
entries.zh: 他把那封尚未写完的信藏在一摞报纸下面。

entries.en: Jeez, I didn't realise the queue went all the way around the building.
entries.zh: 哎呀，我没想到队伍竟然绕了整栋楼一圈。

entries.en: Aargh, the document closed before I had saved my last paragraph.
entries.zh: 啊，我还没保存最后一段，文档就关闭了。

entries.en: Naw, I'll walk rather than wait for the next bus.
entries.zh: 不了，我宁可走路，也不等下一班公交车了。

entries.en: Ahem, I think you've forgotten the question I actually asked.
entries.zh: 呃哼，我想你已经忘了我实际问的那个问题。

entries.en: Ciao, I'll send you the photographs when I get home.
entries.zh: 再见，等我到家就把照片发给你。

entries.en: Hiya, I didn't expect to see you at this exhibition.
entries.zh: 嗨，我没想到会在这个展览上碰到你。

entries.en: Crikey, I hadn't realised how steep the path becomes after the bridge.
entries.zh: 哎呀，我还真没想到过桥后这条路会变得这么陡。

entries.en: Hurray, the committee has finally agreed to reopen the village library.
entries.zh: 好哇，委员会终于同意重新开放村里的图书馆了。

entries.en: Yippee, we've finished the group project before the deadline.
entries.zh: 好耶，我们在截止时间之前完成小组项目了。

entries.en: Just tighten the last screw, and voila, the shelf is ready.
entries.zh: 只要拧紧最后一颗螺丝——瞧，架子就装好了。

entries.en: Attaboy, you kept trying even after the first design fell apart.
entries.zh: 好样的，第一次设计失败后，你仍然坚持尝试。

entries.en: Atishoo! I sneezed just as the room fell silent.
entries.zh: 阿嚏！房间刚安静下来，我就打了个喷嚏。
